what: Photo slots (item) of different sizes overlap at the center of the board, then after 1.4s they scatter over .8s cubic-bezier(.105,.401,.222,.939) to their own vw·vh positions. The whole board (field) shifts opposite the mouse by ±30vw·±30vh, following only .1 of the remaining distance each frame so it glides heavily, and each slot can be given its own extra shift share (--fx-dx·--fx-dy). Hovering a photo scales it to 1.4x over .3s and raises it to the top, the title of the same order turns on, and the round cursor turns on from 7em→11em (.05s) — the cursor follows at .12 per frame. Pressing gathers the board and slots to the center in 1s, only the pressed slot grows to 1x over .8s, and it moves to the link at 1.777s. Below 768px they stack vertically with no motion, leaving only the title reveal

options.on: Start signal (document event name) — if you give the event fired when the loader ends, delay counts from then. If none, it starts on attach
options.range-x · range-y: Max distance the panel is pushed away from the mouse (vw·vh), default 30·30
options.smooth: Share left over each frame (0–1), default .9 — the larger, the slower it follows
options.cursor-smooth: Share the cursor leaves behind, default .88
options.grow · grow-ease: Length (.8) and curve (0.596,0.05,0.216,0.98) for the pressed cell growing to 1x
options.go: Seconds from click until navigating to the link, default 1.777 — 0 means no navigation, it only gathers (demo/app)
options.[data-fx-part=field]: Panel pushed by the mouse (the whole part if absent)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Photo cell — via style: --fx-x·--fx-y (scatter position, vw·vh·px)·--fx-s (scale)·--fx-z (stacking order)·--fx-dx·--fx-dy (extra shift beyond the panel, vw·vh, negative moves toward the mouse)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Image or link that grows inside the cell (the whole cell if none)
options.[data-fx-part=title]: Name in the same order as the cell — gets .is-on when activated
